description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'terms' in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting terms, with access control and database interactions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::Terms
classes.description: Controller class for managing terms in the admin interface, handling CRUD operations and rendering templates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles listing all terms, generating URLs for viewing, editing, and deleting each term, and passing data to the template.

methods.name: new_terms
methods.description: Prepares a new term with a default 'valid_from' date, and renders the edit template for creation.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a term by ID and stores it in the stash, or detaches with a not found error.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a term if it is not marked to be kept, then redirects to the index.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing or creating a term, setting the submit URL and template.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new term and delegates to 'update_or_create' for saving.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Saves the term, either updating existing or inserting new, then redirects accordingly.
